card.name: Reference and citation cues in documentation
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation just before a cross-reference or citation, such as 'See also:', '(see Section', or a statute title ending in 'Act'. It appears in technical manuals and legal or reference text.

modes.label: See-also cues
modes.description: The word 'also' or a colon after 'See', or a bracket before 'see Section', leading into a list of related items.

modes.description: The end of an Act title or a 'Stat.' citation in legal text.
